parsed.answer: This has been reported before. In PowerToys#30090, zones activate on every window drag even though only 'Use a non-primary mouse button to toggle zone activation' is enabled; pressing the non-primary button then turns zones off instead of on. The workaround from the related discussion is that FancyZones only stays inactive by default when 'Hold Shift key to activate zones while dragging' is also enabled together with the non-primary mouse button option (PowerToys#16247 describes the same combination). So enable both options, and then zones will appear only when you hold Shift or press the non-primary button. Note that #30090 has no confirmed fix, and a commenter there noted FancyZones can keep the toggled state between drags, so if it still activates by default, try restarting PowerToys. If the behaviour persists with both options set, add your details and bug report to PowerToys#30090.
